_comment: Benchmark baseline for the Load & Soak Tests job (pr-integration.yml). Each p95Ms is the SLOWEST p95 that endpoint recorded across the nine green CI runs listed in _runs (ubuntu-latest, the 1.5M-row load-test dataset), so the 50% tolerance Test-LoadAndBenchmark.ps1 applies is 50% beyond the worst that runner noise has produced, not beyond a typical run. A regression is a warning on the pull request, not a failure. To refresh it: take the BENCHMARK p95 lines from recent green runs and keep the per-endpoint maximum. Do not paste in a run from your own machine: the comparison is only meaningful runner to runner.
